title_zh: 加密货币卷土重来?比特币、监管与配置新趋势 | Zach Pandl（Grayscale）与 Michael Buccella（Neoclassic Capital）
subtitle_zh: 主持人 Dominic Chu 对话 Grayscale 研究主管 Zach Pandl 与 Neoclassic Capital 合伙人 Michael Buccella,剖析这轮加密反弹的可持续性、监管清晰度与 ETF 配置趋势。
summary_zh: 本期 ETF Edge 由 Dominic Chu 主持，对话 Grayscale Investments 研究主管 Zach Pandl 与 Neoclassic Capital 管理合伙人 Michael Buccella，剖析这轮加密货币反弹能否持续。Buccella 从技术面看：经历 8 月 19 日的高杠杆洗盘后，现货与 ETF 买盘跟进夯实底部，看涨期权未平仓量上升而期货未平仓量下降，说明杠杆被压低、真实增持需求存在；但他提醒山寨币杠杆仍偏高，宜谨慎累积比特币。Pandl 则点出两大基本面驱动：一是对稀缺性的需求——不受约束的政府债务增长带来法币风险，把投资者推向黄金与比特币这类稀缺资产；二是区块链获得监管清晰（regulatory clarity）并融入主流金融。两人谈到 Clarity 法案虽仍有不确定性，但 SEC、CFTC 已通过机构指引（如批准永续期货、通用上市标准 generic listing standards、Reg Crypto）带来清晰，稳定币则由去年的 Genius 法案立法推进。节目还讨论 ETF 产品创新（如 Goldman 获批的备兑看涨比特币 ETF）、增强收益与期权权利金（premium）策略向高波动加密资产的迁移，以及质押（staking）限制与多元化配置。是一集关于加密监管清晰化与机构配置趋势的及时解读。

turns.en: BETF Edge podcast is sponsored by Invesco QQQ. Let's rethink possibility. Invesco Distributors, Inc. Welcome to ETF Edge, the podcast. If you're looking to learn the latest insights on all things exchange traded funds, you're in the right place. Every week, we're bringing you compelling interviews, thoughtful market analysis, and breaking down what it all means for investors.
turns.zh: ETF Edge 播客由 Invesco QQQ 赞助。让我们重新想象可能性。Invesco Distributors, Inc. 欢迎收听 ETF Edge 播客。如果你想了解关于交易所交易基金（ETF）的最新洞见,那你可来对地方了。每周我们都会为你带来精彩的访谈、深入的市场分析,并拆解这一切对投资者究竟意味着什么。

turns.en: I'm your host, Dominic Chu. So what's driving the recent crypto comeback and is it sustainable? Here's my conversation with Zach Pandle, the head of research over at Grayscale Investments, along with Michael Buccella, who's the managing partner at Neoclassic Capital.
turns.zh: 我是你们的主持人 Dominic Chu。那么,是什么推动了最近这轮加密货币的反弹,它又能否持续呢?接下来是我和 Grayscale Investments 的研究主管 Zach Pandl 的对话,同时还有 Neoclassic Capital 的管理合伙人 Michael Buccella。

turns.en: Gentlemen, thank you very much for taking the time to be with us here at ETF Edge. I'd like to start maybe with a bigger picture of you and for that, I'll turn to you, Mike, on this.
turns.zh: 两位先生,非常感谢你们抽出时间来到 ETF Edge。我想先从大局谈起,关于这一点,我来请 Mike 先说说。

turns.en: The Bitcoin run-up. It's been fast and furious, but again, you have to kind of see where we came from. We're still a long way away from the record highs that we've seen.
turns.zh: 比特币这轮上涨来得又快又猛,但话说回来,你也得看看我们是从哪儿走过来的。我们距离之前所见的历史高点,其实还很遥远。

turns.en: Is there anything to the price action lately that makes you feel as though this is somewhat sustainable? Yeah. So I guess the way that I think about Bitcoin levels here is we had some pretty significant leverage. That was August 19 washout. So we had short, get liquidated.
turns.zh: 最近的价格走势里,有没有什么迹象让你觉得这轮行情多少是可持续的?嗯,我想我看待当前比特币价位的方式是这样的:我们之前经历了相当高的杠杆,那是 8 月 19 日的那次洗盘,空头被强制平仓。

turns.en: We had pretty decent follow-through on spot and ETF buying, which was good to see because that's very healthy in terms of building out of base. And then what we also saw was an increase in options open interest, particularly with CallsQ. And while we also saw a decline in futures open interest, so leverage was reduced while spot buying increased and then upside buying was increasing.
turns.zh: 随后现货和 ETF 买盘跟进得相当不错,这很好,因为对于夯实底部来说这是非常健康的。我们还看到期权未平仓量在上升,尤其是看涨期权;同时期货未平仓量却在下降,所以杠杆被压低了,而现货买盘在增加,向上的买盘也在增加。

turns.en: So that to me indicated that there was real demand to own Bitcoin incrementally from here. We're still down on the year. We're still well off all-time highs. The next levels to watch are roughly 83,000 to 86,000. We have a lot of long-term supply to chew through. And if we get past there, we're in pretty good territory. And if you look at Bitcoin relative to the rest of the market, it's in a lot healthier position. I think I said earlier on the program,
turns.zh: 所以在我看来,这表明从这里往下,增持比特币的需求是实实在在存在的。我们年内到现在仍是下跌的,距离历史高点也还差得远。接下来值得关注的价位大致在 83,000 到 86,000 之间,我们要消化大量的长期供应筹码。如果我们能突破那里,就进入了相当不错的区域。再看看比特币相对整个其他市场的表现,它处于一个健康得多的位置。我想我之前在节目里也说过,

turns.en: altcoin open interest and leverage is getting a little bit worrisome. So overall leverage open interest is about the same as it was before the October 2025 crash. And so I don't necessarily take that as caution or a flashing red light that we're about to head into a collapse in the market.
turns.zh: 山寨币的未平仓量和杠杆有点令人担忧。所以整体的杠杆未平仓量和 2025 年 10 月那次崩盘之前大致相当。因此我并不一定把它当作一个警告,或者一个预示市场即将崩盘的红灯。

turns.en: I'm just saying you want to tread carefully. And in this environment, maybe just incrementally accumulate your Bitcoin and then be a little bit more cautious as you go out the risk curve.
turns.zh: 我只是说,你要谨慎前行。在这种环境里,也许就一点点地累积你的比特币,然后在沿着风险曲线往外走的时候更谨慎一些。

turns.en: Interesting, Zach, because this conversation as well has centered a lot on the price action of Bitcoin. We haven't spoken relatively as much about some of the other larger coins out there, namely Ethereum, namely Ether and Solana, maybe XRP and others. We have talked a little bit about hyper liquid. So when it comes to what's been driving the price action, there have been some macro factors at play. So what in your mind has been the reason why we've seen other than the
turns.zh: 很有意思,Zach,因为你这场对话同样很大程度上围绕着比特币的价格走势。我们相对没怎么谈其他一些较大的币种,也就是以太坊（Ethereum/Ether）和 Solana,可能还有 XRP 等等。我们稍微聊了一点 Hyperliquid。那么在推动价格走势的因素当中,有一些宏观因素在起作用。所以在你看来,除了——

turns.en: technical stuff that Mike referred to? Are there fundamental reasons why from a macro perspective people have gotten back into cryptocurrencies? There are. And it's really the same to fundamental drivers that have been pushing the asset class forward for a long time. Number one is demand for scarcity. We have risks with fiat currencies created by unchecked government debt growth.
turns.zh: ——Mike 提到的那些技术面因素之外,从宏观角度,人们重新买入加密货币,有没有什么基本面上的原因?有的。其实正是长期以来推动这一资产类别前进的同样两大基本面驱动力。第一,是对稀缺性的需求。不受约束的政府债务增长,带来了法定货币方面的风险。

turns.en: That's driving investors into scarce assets, whether it's physical gold or digital Bitcoin. But that's only half of the story for digital assets. The other half is regulatory clarity for blockchain technology and integrating blockchains into mainstream finance. And that's been moving ahead as well. Now, we'll talk about the Clarity Act in a moment. There is some uncertainty there.
turns.zh: 这把投资者推向稀缺资产,无论是实物黄金还是数字化的比特币。但这只是数字资产故事的一半。另一半,是区块链技术获得监管上的清晰,以及把区块链融入主流金融。这方面也一直在推进。我们一会儿会谈到 Clarity 法案,那里还有一些不确定性。

turns.en: But even with that piece of legislation aside, the key regulators and the White House, the SCC, the CFTC have been bringing regulatory clarity to the industry regardless. And this benefits the rest of the ecosystem, particularly the smart contract space like Ethereum and Solana, perpetual futures, platforms like hyper liquid, these benefit from regulatory clarity in addition to that scarcity or debasement trade, if you will. So it's both of those things, demand for scarcity
turns.zh: 但即便抛开那项立法不谈,关键的监管机构、白宫、SEC、CFTC,无论如何都一直在为这个行业带来监管上的清晰度。这惠及整个生态系统的其余部分,尤其是以太坊和 Solana 这样的智能合约领域、Hyperliquid 这样的永续期货平台——除了那种稀缺性/货币贬值交易之外,它们还从监管清晰中受益。所以是这两件事兼具:对稀缺性的需求,

turns.en: and portfolio diversification, as well as regulatory clarity for the industry and asset class. So let's follow up, Zach, with that because you brought up clarity because I mentioned it in the introduction here. How much is the momentum that we've seen in cryptocurrencies contingent upon clearer clarity in terms of the regulatory framework around cryptocurrencies? Is the Clarity Act crucial to the longer term success of cryptocurrencies, especially when it comes
turns.zh: 以及投资组合的多元化,还有这个行业和这一资产类别在监管上的清晰。那我们接着往下谈,Zach,因为你提到了清晰度,我在开场这里也提到了。我们在加密货币上看到的热潮,有多大程度取决于围绕加密货币监管框架更明确的清晰?Clarity 法案对于加密货币、尤其对于美国市场及其投资者的长期成功,是不是至关重要的?

turns.en: to the U.S. market and its investors? Regulatory clarity in general is absolutely crucial. This is financial technology. We need a clear rulebook to protect investors, protect consumers, to protect the financial system itself. We don't necessarily need the Clarity Act, that specific piece of legislation. And we've been very encouraged by the recent steps by the CFTC, for example, to approve perpetual futures here in the U.S. market by the SCC for laying out
turns.zh: 对于美国市场及其投资者来说是否至关重要?监管清晰度整体上绝对是关键。这是金融科技,我们需要一本清晰的规则手册来保护投资者、保护消费者、保护金融体系本身。我们未必需要 Clarity 法案这项具体的立法。我们一直受到 CFTC 近期举措的很大鼓舞,比如批准永续期货在美国市场推出,以及 SEC 就过户代理（transfer agent）变革、加密代币发行(即所谓的 Reg Crypto)制定了一些基本规则。

turns.en: some ground rules around transfer agent changes, around issuance of crypto tokens, what's called Reg Crypto. So we're getting that regulatory clarity through agency guidance, rather than through legislation. For stablecoins, we went a legislative path, got the Genius Act last year, that was a great step forward for stablecoins. We may be taking a different path forward for the rest of the industry, but I think we are still getting that clarity and it absolutely is crucial,
turns.zh: 所以我们正通过机构指引、而非立法来获得这种监管清晰度。稳定币方面,我们走的是立法路线,去年通过了 Genius 法案,那是稳定币的一大进步。我们也许正在为行业的其余部分走一条不同的路,但我认为我们依然在获得那种清晰,而且它绝对至关重要,

turns.en: encouraging, we are seeing it every day with the announcements from these agencies. It's interesting, Mike, because the last time we spoke, we were on CNBC air for power launch and it was just around the time when there were some kind of last minute hiccups and on the path for the Clarity Act to get some real momentum. And we had talked a little bit about just how important the Clarity Act is. I wonder, since then, have you maybe altered your view in some way or not at all
turns.zh: 令人鼓舞——我们每天都在看到这些机构发布的新公告。有意思,Mike,因为我们上一次交谈是在 CNBC 的节目上,正好是 Clarity 法案在获得真正势头前的路上遇到一些最后关头波折的那阵子。我们当时聊过 Clarity 法案有多重要。我想知道,从那时到现在,你的看法有没有以某种方式改变,还是根本没变——

turns.en: about whether Clarity and that Clarity Act is something that we really do need for this next leg of the markets to go higher? Yeah, I think it's kind of towards what Zach was saying, is I think we're kind of in this unbundling phase of the areas of regulation that we're looking to push forward. So, you know, I think back then I had said, you know, we'd love to see the Clarity Act, you know, move forward, but we've done just fine without government direction in the past,
turns.zh: 关于 Clarity、关于 Clarity 法案是否是我们这轮市场继续走高真正需要的东西?嗯,我觉得这和 Zach 说的差不多,就是我们正处于一种把我们要推进的监管领域拆开来的拆分阶段。回想那时候我说过,我们希望看到 Clarity 法案推进,但过去在没有政府指引的情况下我们也干得挺好,

turns.en: and we will continue to do it and move forward. And I think we have the right folks lobbying, obviously, you know, everyone has their own fiefdoms and people are going to lobby for the things that interact most kindly with their existing business lines. But I think generally speaking, we're in a very good environment where the private sector is doing a very good job of informing the public sector on what we're trying to do. And I think we're getting progress. I still,
turns.zh: 而且我们会继续这样推进下去。我想我们找对了人去游说——当然,每个人都有自己的势力范围,大家都会为最贴合自己现有业务线的东西去游说。但总体而言,我们处在一个很好的环境里,私营部门在很好地向我们想做的事情上给公共部门提供信息。我认为我们正在取得进展。我仍然,

turns.en: you know, unfortunately, don't see a likelihood that we get the Clarity Act passed near term. And then obviously we had into midterm elections and that could obviously solve a number of things, including Clarity. But, you know, I think generally, we're doing just fine educating the government, the public sector and regulators. And I think we're going to continue to get support from those who are open to having productive dialogue with us.
turns.zh: 很遗憾,在短期内看不到 Clarity 法案通过的可能性。然后马上要进入中期选举,那显然可能会解决很多问题,包括 Clarity。但总的来说,我们在教育政府、公共部门和监管者方面做得挺好。我认为我们会继续获得那些愿意与我们开展建设性对话的人的支持。

turns.en: Now, Zach, speaking of that dialogue, the regulatory framework is important here as well, because it does provide at least some guardrails. People feel a little bit more comfortable.
turns.zh: 现在,Zach,说到那种对话,监管框架在这里同样很关键,因为它至少提供了一些护栏,让人们感觉更安心一些。

turns.en: One place that they've seen a lot more of that happen and really evolve quickly is in the world of exchange traded products that track many of these crypto assets. It's broadened out the total addressable market to investors and traders who aren't necessarily crypto native, but want to have some kind of exposure and you've given them by the framework that we have, more vehicles by which to do so through traditional markets, centralized markets.
turns.zh: 他们看到这种变化大量发生、并且快速演进的一个领域,是在追踪这些加密资产的交易型产品（ETP）世界里。它把可触达的市场扩大到了那些不一定是加密原住民、但想要某种敞口的投资者和交易者,而凭借我们现有的框架,你通过传统市场、集中化市场,给了他们更多去做这件事的工具。

turns.en: Grayscale is one of those people, is one of those firms that has offered these types of products. So how much has this dynamic around regulatory scrutiny been helped by that cooperation with regulators on issuing these exchange traded products? And is that big for the driver of this next leg higher? Yeah, absolutely. Grayscale has been one of those players that's had a long engagement with regulators on these topics. You think back to the first ETF filings for Bitcoin
turns.zh: Grayscale 就是提供这类产品的公司之一。那么这种围绕监管审查的动态,在多大程度上得益于与监管机构在发行这些交易型产品上的合作?这对下一轮上涨是不是一个大的推动力?是的,绝对是。Grayscale 一直是与监管机构在这些议题上长期接触的参与者之一。回想一下比特币 ETF 最早的申报,

turns.en: were in 2013, they didn't come to market until 2024, almost 11 years later. So it was a lot of process to bring those first products to market. But we've had a streamlining now, I think thanks to some of the current regulators. Last year, the SEC created something called generic listing standards, which gives an asset manager like ourselves a pretty clear roadmap on when and where and how we can issue new ETF products. So we're broadening that exposure for our clients.
turns.zh: 是在 2013 年,直到 2024 年才上市,差不多 11 年之后。所以把这些最初的产品推向市场经历了大量的流程。但现在我们已经有了一个精简化的流程,我想这要归功于现任的一些监管者。去年 SEC 创建了所谓的通用上市标准（generic listing standards）,这给像我们这样的资产管理公司提供了一张相当清晰的路线图,告诉我们何时、何地、如何发行新的 ETF 产品。所以我们在为客户拓宽那种敞口。

turns.en: One of the great things about these products is they're kind of the easy button for crypto investing. There's lots of different ways to buy crypto, no wrong way necessary way to do it.
turns.zh: 这些产品的一大好处是,它们可以说是加密投资的'简单按钮'。买加密有很多种方式,不一定有哪一种是错的。

turns.en: But you have to solve some things for yourself. Where do you get the liquidity? How do you custody these assets? How do you do your taxes and your estate planning? The ETFs package all of those solutions into a single product, oftentimes at low cost, a product. So they make it very easy for investors. They've had a great success, as you know, since the Bitcoin ETF. So I think ETFs will continue to capture a rising share of the crypto asset class because they make investing
turns.zh: 但你得自己解决一些问题:你从哪里获得流动性?你如何托管这些资产?你的税务和遗产规划怎么办?ETF 把所有这些解决方案打包进一个单一的产品,往往还是低成本的产品。所以它们让投资对投资者来说变得非常简单。你已经知道,自比特币 ETF 以来它们取得了巨大的成功。所以我认为 ETF 会继续在加密资产类别中占据不断上升的份额,因为它们让这些资产的投资

turns.en: in these assets straightforward for anybody. Now, Mike, another big point about this whole process is access to these markets and the way that ETFs and ETPs have kind of done so and propelled this kind of current leg. We've also seen a lot more of a variety of these ETF products come to market tracking, not just Bitcoin, but other parts of the market as well, because the regulatory framework has been, Lucent is not the right term, but it's allowed for more of these
turns.zh: 对任何人来说都变得简单明了。现在,Mike,关于这整个流程还有一个重要点,就是进入这些市场的途径,以及 ETF 和 ETP 在这方面所做的,并推动了当前这一轮。我们也看到更多样化的 ETF 产品上市,追踪的不只是比特币,还有市场的其他部分,因为监管框架一直是……'宽松'这个词不太准确,但它确实让更多这类产品

turns.en: products to come to market in a quicker fashion. I wonder how much you think investors and traders who are not necessarily as deep into crypto as you and Zach are, Mike, to go and maybe get more into places that are not just Bitcoin, but to other places that people talk about, maybe in the news, but maybe don't talk about as much as Bitcoin or Ether.
turns.zh: 以更快速的方式进入市场。我想知道,Mike,对于那些不像你和 Zach 那样深入加密领域的投资者和交易者,你觉得他们在多大程度上会走向更多的地方——不只是比特币,而是走向人们会谈论、也许新闻里会出现、但不像比特币或以太那样被频繁讨论的其他领域?

turns.en: Yeah. It's funny you mentioned the Bitcoin ETFs. I was actually in Switzerland in the mountains the day they first started trading in 2024. So it's a nice little camera story. And it's also nice that Zach and I, both ex-Goldman colleagues saw our alma mater issue a new approval for, I think, a call over writing Bitcoin ETF today. So a lot going on in this space. I would say we probably need to get, we need to be quicker to allowing further ETF distribution or creation
turns.zh: 嗯,你提到比特币 ETF 挺有意思的。2024 年它们第一天开始交易的时候,我其实正在瑞士的群山里,所以这是个挺不错的小故事。也很棒的是,Zach 和我——两个高盛（Goldman）的前同事——今天看到我们的母校获得了一项新批准,我想是发行一只备兑看涨（covered call）比特币 ETF。这个领域发生了很多事情。我想说,我们可能需要更快一些,去允许进一步的 ETF 发行或创设,

turns.en: and distribution. Unfortunately, I think the lack of clarity, not the act, just clarity broadly, led to an over issuance of public holding companies of the long tail of all coins and led to what was kind of a bubble in digital asset treasury issuance last year. And a lot of those structures were very toxic and a lot of retail got burnt on those. And so I think, from my perspective, you have really, I would say, good stewards of capital. So before the hyperliquity ETF was issued,
turns.zh: 以及分销。不幸的是,我认为缺乏清晰度——不是那个法案,而是广义上的清晰——导致了长尾所有币种的公开控股公司过度发行,并催生了去年数字资产财库（digital asset treasury）发行的那种泡沫。那些结构里有很多非常危险,很多散户在里面吃了大亏。所以从我的角度看,你真的需要……我想说是,良好的资本管家。所以在 Hyperliquid ETF 发行之前,

turns.en: we had Hyperion DeFi was the first to come along and buy hyperliquity in a public company and really engage with the ecosystem, make strong investments and I would say act very responsibly as a fiduciary for the shareholders. And then you had per hyperliquity strategies. And then you had the hyperliquity ETF issued. And you have this much more neutral safe exposure that was stewarded again by more responsible digital asset treasury holding companies.

turns.en: I think evolution is exactly the right word to be using here. When people approach digital assets for the first time, they tend to think of specific use cases. turns.zh: 我认为'演进'正是这里应该用的词。当人们第一次接触数字资产时,他们往往想到的是具体的用例——比特币是数字黄金啦,或者我听说过稳定币啦,或者我对永续期货感到兴奋啦。我们鼓励人们把数字资产看作一个行业、一个资产类别。你今天面对的,是一个大约 3 万亿美元的资产类别,一个中等规模的另类资产类别,里面有很多不同的有趣资产。我们认为人们

turns.en: should take a diversified approach, capture Bitcoin, capture Ethereum, capture hyperliquid in the same diversified portfolio. I think that's the direction of travel. turns.zh: 但随着你获得更高的产品效率、随着你获得更多教育,我们认为最终那就是前进的方向。一种多元化的组合方式,与风险投资（venture）或私募股权（private equity）等其他另类资产并列,应该是你的加密配置那一块——不只是比特币,不只是以太,而是一个多元化的组合。那么在你走之前,最后一个问题。
